seo.title: Right of petition | Orión Lex
seo.description: We draft and file petitions before public and private entities, and follow up on the response. Online service throughout Colombia.

cta.label: Request advice
cta.message: Hello, I saw the Orión Lex website and I need help with a petition.

hero.lead: Do you need a response from an entity and have not received it?
paragraphs: The right of petition allows you to request information, documents, corrections or actions from public entities and, in certain cases, from private companies. The entity must give a substantive response within the time limits set by law.
hero.emphasis: At ORIÓN LEX we help you draft and file your petition with the right legal grounds for your case.

cases.title: When can it help you?
items: You need information or copies of documents.
You want to request the correction of data or records.
You have a claim against a health, pension or utility provider.
You want a right to be recognized.
You filed a petition and have not received a response.

steps.title: Diagnosis
steps.description: We review your situation and what you need from the entity.

steps.title: Drafting
steps.description: We prepare the petition with the facts, the requests and the applicable legal grounds.

steps.title: Filing and follow-up
steps.description: We file it with the entity and track the response deadlines.

steps.title: Next steps
steps.description: If the response does not arrive or does not resolve your request, we explain the actions available.

items.question: How long does the entity have to respond?
items.answer: As a general rule, 15 business days. For requests for documents and information the deadline is 10 business days, and for consultations, 30 business days (Law 1755 of 2015).

items.question: What happens if they do not respond?
items.answer: Failing to respond violates the fundamental right of petition and can be challenged through a tutela action.

items.question: Can I file a petition with a private company?
items.answer: Yes, in the cases established by law, for example with banks, insurers or service companies. We check whether your case allows it.

closing.title: Tell us what you need
closing.text: Write to us on WhatsApp and we will tell you how to file your petition.
closing.coverage: We work online throughout Colombia and with people living abroad who need to resolve legal matters in the country.
